_comment: Rules of skill communicate-valuation-scenarios. A rule computes only if its status is VERIFIED-REOPENED or ENGINEERING RULE; a [CHECK] rule is disabled and the script prints [CHECK].

rules.passage: A fairness opinion is issued by a member with required disclosures of role, compensation and verification, under written procedures; Item 1015 requires a summary of procedures, findings and bases of an outside report.

rules.reason: every line points to a register row so a reader can audit it; same rule as the integrated report of the due diligence plugin
recommendation, fairness / solvency and single-value phrase patterns are the plugin's own lists
rules.gap: lists are not exhaustive; a person reviews every line

rules.reason: owner ruling V5: the adopted valuation, the choice of rate and any fairness or solvency view are human only
